finding.classification: retained-but-unlisted partial artifact / self-reporting limitation; not observed loss, process-cleanup fault or archive defect
finding.resolution: Pre-admission root-owned bounded independent actual-output inventory on success/failure; generated is nonexhaustive. Root condition confirmed by direct parent instruction during review. No target source modification.

required_root_gate: Fresh ROOT-ADMISSION binds exact PLAN, worker, all inputs and both critic review files before one launch.

Admission explicitly owns fixed-scope actual output inventory with path/type/size/hash/mode and truthful partial/final/error states on success and failure. Refuse unexpected artifacts, partial/missing result or inspection error; never convert failed inspection to absence.

Only root-verified successful source output may progress to whole retained bitmap inspection; any actual process/content/cap/inventory failure closes without retry, repair, alternate filename or image decision.
execution_scope: One direct stdlib Python process, python3 -I -B read_source.py <root-admission-sha>, exact one MHMAT and at most its one literal diffuse; alarm15s/CPU5s, no subprocess, model/native/GPU/browser or external retrieval. No critic execution admitted.
limits: No actual archive directory/member/texture bytes decoded in review.
No IHDR/CRC/actual texture usefulness, mode or output success claimed before the reader.
Unresolved legacy shader declarations are preserved reference text, not runnable material dependencies.
Payload/file caps and alarm/CPU limits are not hard RSS, complete-startup or performance qualification.
No new memory lookup, network, browser, capture, image generation, target/helper import/evaluation or source/product modification.
collection: Exclusive two-file write; review re-read and both output hashes reported externally. Receipt self-digest is external to avoid circular binding.
